stock.description: As an investment holding company, Ruihe Data Technology Holdings Ltd. specializes in providing comprehensive big data, artificial intelligence, and digital marketing solutions, complemented by professional advisory services. The firm caters to financial institutions and a wide array of other enterprises, aiming to empower them to fully unlock the intrinsic value of their data and expedite their data-driven digital transformation. Established on March 25, 2004, the company operates primarily from its headquarters in Hangzhou, China.
